text:
Maya: Heads-up — int8 candidate (qint8-v2) from yesterday's bring-up is showing a rerank quality drop on our promptset. Quick check: BLEU/RR down ~4-6% on the canary. Not huge but consistent across multiple intents.
Jun: ugh. Which promptset slice? longform or short-turns?
Maya: Short-turn QA and multi-step instruction prompts. I ran the eval harness: \n```\n./eval_harness --model qint8-v2 --prompts promptsets/short_qc_2026.json --metrics rerank,bleu,exact_match --out out/qint8-v2-short.json\n```\nLogs show skew in top-3 rerank scores vs baseline. sample: "correct" moved from rank1->rank3 for ~120/3000 examples.
Priya: Can you paste an example where the top answer changed? We should check if it's deid/tokenizer issue after quant.
Maya: pasted one in the thread: "User asks: How to reset API key?" baseline answer contained exact step-by-step; qint8-v2 returned a shorter paraphrase missing step 2. Not a tokenizer cut-off, looks semantic.
Theo: tagging label-bot to run a micro-golden recheck on those 120 examples. @label-bot queue-add --name "qint8-v2-rerank-120" --priority high --golden true
label-bot: Added batch qint8-v2-rerank-120 (120 items) to the golden validation queue. ETA for human relabel: 12h. React with :eyes: when you want auto-accept from senior labelers.
Jun: Before we trigger relabeling, can we ensure these aren't duplicates or paraphrase collisions? Our dedupe folded several paraphrases last week.
Priya: I'll run a fast fingerprint compare: md5 of normalized prompt text vs samplebank. If collision rate > 5% we should dedupe first.
Maya: run: `python tools/fingerprint_check.py --input out/qint8-v2-short.json --threshold 0.9` — results posted in ~15.
(15m later)
Priya: fingerprint report: 8 duplicates, 5 near-duplicates (0.85-0.95), rest unique. Not enough to explain systematic drift.
Theo: ok proceed with golden relabel for the 120 unique-ish items. Also create a micro-canary deploy route pinned to qint8-v2 for 2% of traffic so we can collect live signals.
Maya: created canary: route "canary/qint8-v2-2pct" and pushed config. Deploy job id 78910.
Jun: parallel ask to infra: add latency and token-cost buckets to the canary dashboard. We want to ensure no perf regression masking quality issues.
Maya: infra done. Dashboard link: https://console/redwood/canaries/78910 (internal)
Priya: labeling plan: use 2-step: (1) blind pair relabel for correctness (senior), (2) probe prompts with adversarial paraphrases. I assigned 3 senior labelers and added a micro-golden guardrail.
label-bot: Golden guardrail created: threshold 0.92 pass. Alerts -> #eng-ml if rate fails.
Jun: also schedule a quant-sensitivity run: same eval harness but sweep over kv_cache_enabled and prefilling flags. Maybe a kernel fallback interacts with low-precision math.
Maya: added job: `./quant_sweep --model qint8-v2 --flags kv_cache:{on,off} --prefill:{none,light}`. Kickoff 12:30 PT.
Theo: if golden relabel indicates model-quality gap, hold deploy and fallback to qint8-v1 for canary. Who owns the decision?
Maya: I'll make the call with input from Priya and Jun. If pass-rate < 0.98 on micro-golden or behavioral delta > 3% we rollback.
Jun: noted. I'll also add a small benchmark: pairwise BERTScore on top-5 answers to capture semantic shifts.
Priya: one more: update promptset metadata to tag these examples with 'qint8-rerank-investigation' and add provenance: eval_harness run id 2026-03-23-1769912345.
Maya: done. I'll post summary in the all-hands if we need infra support. For now: monitor label-bot and canary metrics. :eyes:
Theo: thanks — ping me if the micro-golden hits fail or infra flags latency spike.
